findings.claim: 10-K 自述：新進者與客戶正開發基於開源 NOS 的白盒網通產品，或採拆解式採購搭配自有軟體，替代技術快速被採用可能造成降價壓力、流失銷售。
findings.excerpt: Some of these entities are developing white box networking products based on open-source network operating systems that may be provided for free using off-the-shelf or commoditized hardware technology

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：若無法預期技術變化並及時推出新產品，產品可能過時；800GbE AI 乙太網產品能否維持競爭力取決於交付時程與客戶接受度。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: If we are unable to anticipate technological changes in our industry by introducing new, enhanced or expanded products and services in a timely and cost-effective manner or if we fail to introduce products and services that meet market demand or gain market share, we may lose our competitive position, our products may become obsolete
